subject: Renewal preflight: procurement portal invite + evidence for capacity uplift
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@procurecorp.com>, ProcureCorp Procurement <procure@procurecorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal preflight: procurement portal invite + evidence for capacity uplift

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To keep the renewal and the planned 2x capacity uplift on track for the May 1 effective date, can you do the following before EOD Tuesday (4/15)?

- Send a portal invite for the vendor onboarding workspace (ProcureCorp portal) so we can upload evidence directly. If there are field constraints (max file size / accepted types) please flag them.
- Share the PO numbering / split guidance for accounting (we may need 2 POs: one for base renewal + one for the uplift).
- Confirm whether ProcureCorp requires the SOC 2 artifact bundle or just the attestation summary (we can provide either).

Attached is our internal preflight checklist to speed review. High-level evidence we expect you'll ask for: SOC 2 attestation (PDF), Data flow diagram (png), KMS envelope description, and list of subprocessor contracts.

If there are any SLA edits you need that would affect invoicing cadence, flag those now — legal is on standby for a quick redline.

Thanks — I want to keep this simple for both teams.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Renewals 
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@procurecorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal preflight: procurement portal invite + evidence for capacity uplift

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear list. I've:

1) Created a vendor workspace for Redwood in our portal and sent an invite to stephanie.nguyen@redwood-inference.com (you should see it from procure-do-not-reply@procurecorp.com). Portal accepts PDF/PNG/DOCX up to 25MB per file.

2) Attached our standard SLA template (see ProcureCorp_SLA_template_v2.docx) — we generally accept redlines but need final SLA locked before PO issuance.

3) For PO splitting: we can accept two POs. Please include the uplift in PO #2 and include the base term in PO #1; both POs must reference the same contract id (we will generate once SLA is final).

4) SOC 2: the attestation summary is acceptable for procurement intake; however our legal team may request the full report during contract review. If you can upload the summary now we can proceed.

DocuSign: I will route the contract for signature once procurement confirms the SLA redlines. Expect the DocuSign link after legal does a quick pass — target is Wednesday 4/16.

I've attached the SLA and a sample portal invite email for your records.

Regards,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
ProcureCorp
alicia.gomez@procurecorp.com
[Attachment: ProcureCorp_SLA_template_v2.docx (DOCX, 200KB)]

Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal preflight: procurement portal invite + evidence for capacity uplift

Team — forwarding portal invite and SLA draft from ProcureCorp. TL;DR: they accept SOC 2 summary now, want SLA locked before PO. They also prefer two POs (base + uplift).

Key asks for us:
- Legal: quick redline on ProcureCorp_SLA_template_v2.docx. Can you do a 24–48 hour turnaround?
- Finance: confirm if we can split the renewal into two POs and how that impacts revenue recognition for us; also confirm cost center to include.
- Ops: I'll upload SOC 2 summary + data flow diagram to their portal once we have the invite working.

Attachments included in portal invite: redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx (we already prepared evidence).

If you want to jump on a 15-min sync, I'm available 11–11:30am PT today.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Stephanie / Ben —

Quick read on the SLA draft: legal okays standard term edits; primary item to flag is a lingering "data residency" paragraph that references EU-only hosting — ask ProcureCorp to remove or narrow to "customer-requested residency" (we don't want broad residency obligations).

On PO split: finance is fine with two POs provided the contract id is referenced on both and the invoices map clearly to the two line items. Ben — can you confirm the accounting code and whether we need to route the uplift PO through a different AR queue? If yes, we should note that in the portal upload metadata.

Attachments I prepared: redline_suggestions_SLA.txt (short notes) — will drop into the portal workspace.

If ProcureCorp legal insists on the full SOC 2, escalate to me and I'll coordinate a limited access transmission to their counsel (we can use an NDA + viewer access in Drive).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal (Renewals)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_suggestions_SLA.txt (TXT, 3KB)]

Hi Alicia —

Quick update from our side:

- SLA redlines uploaded to the portal (file: redline_suggestions_SLA.txt). Laura flagged the data residency paragraph; please confirm ProcureCorp legal can narrow to customer-requested residency only.
- SOC 2 attestation summary and data flow diagram uploaded to your workspace (links included in portal). We limited file sizes per your portal constraints.
- Finance confirms we can accept two POs; Ben has assigned AR code RED-378. Ben — please advise if ProcureCorp needs a different invoice routing address.

Next steps from your side: send DocuSign once legal confirms SLA language (you mentioned targeting Wed 4/16). Once signed, we'll expect the first PO (base) and then PO #2 for the uplift.

Links for your convenience: portal invite (https://procurecorp.portal/req/INVITE-39210) and our shared evidence folder (https://drive.redwood-inference.com/shared/ProcureCorp/RenewalEvidence).

Thanks and looking forward to the DocuSign.

Best,
